title: Campaign Setup Specification
description: Operator-authored input file that describes a campaign and the assets to ingest. Lives in the IPTS shared folder alongside the experiment data.

campaign_slug.description: Short, unique, machine-friendly identifier for this campaign within the IPTS (e.g. 'dac_brucite_a').

assembly_type.description: High-pressure assembly type used in this campaign.

description.description: Human-readable description of the campaign (free text).

owners.description: FedID / username list of the campaign owners.

runs.description: List of run numbers in this campaign. Used for SEEMeta auto-ingestion and for validating run-scoped assets.

seemeta_dir.description: Path (relative to shared_root) of the directory containing per-run SEEMeta JSON files. SEEMeta will be ingested for every run listed in 'runs'. Set to null to suppress SEEMeta ingestion.

seemeta_filename_pattern.description: Python format string for building SEEMeta filenames from run numbers. The only available variable is 'run' (integer).

assets.description: List of raw assets to ingest into the managed asset store.

path.description: Path to the source file. Relative paths are resolved against shared_root.

asset_id.description: Stable logical identifier. Defaults to the file stem if omitted.

run_number.description: Run number for run-scoped assets. Omit for campaign-scoped assets.

notes.description: Optional free-text note stored in provenance.

bin_masks.description: Swiss-cheese bin-mask artefacts to register. These are already-computed mask JSON files derived from UB matrices.

mask_path.description: Path to the swiss-cheese JSON file. Relative paths are resolved against shared_root.

source_run.description: Run number from which the UB matrices were determined.

ub_mat_paths.description: Paths to the ISAW .mat UB matrix files used to build this mask. Relative paths are resolved against shared_root.

width_coef.description: Polynomial width coefficients used when building the mask.

is_lite.description: Whether the mask targets Lite (18 432-pixel) mode.

manual_bin_masks.description: Manually-created swiss-cheese bin-mask artefacts to register. Use when a mask JSON was built interactively (e.g. d-spacing diamond peaks identified in Workbench) rather than auto-generated from UB matrices or the transmission monitor.

mask_path.description: Absolute path to the swiss-cheese JSON file saved by the user.

run_number.description: Run number this mask applies to. Omit for a campaign-wide mask.

notes.description: Optional free-text note stored in provenance.

nxs_path.description: Path to the .nxs pixel mask file. Relative paths are resolved against shared_root.

ws_name.description: Mantid workspace name for this mask.

run_number.description: Run number for run-scoped masks. Omit for campaign-scoped masks.

planned_attenuations.description: PE attenuation workspace artefacts to pre-declare as 'planned' (R7 mitigation).
